messages:
hana: Quick morning sync for the SI onboarding checklist. We're consolidating marketplace listing, HW kit SOP, and the trainer certification. Can we confirm owners?

liam: I can own the marketplace listing and the sample perf table. Need final solution brief + logos by Thu.

cristina: I'll take the HW kit SOP and inventory. Waiting on procurement to confirm serials. Will gate shipping until NDA is green.

ben: Certification owner here. Drafted a 3-step micro-credential (boot, run, submit case). Need SME review for lab exercises. Kevin, you free to review tomorrow?

kevin: Yep I'll do a pass tomorrow AM. Also note: update CLI examples to new `--env=` flag across lab docs. Found one slide that still uses the old region flag.

ops-bot: Alert: Pending NDAs for shipments: "Nimble SI", "Vector Integrations".

cristina: Nimble not signed yet. I'll hold their kit and ping legal.

hana: Shipping policy: do not send kits before NDA + customs paperwork ok. Add to SOP. Liam, add a short market blurb about supported regions in the listing.

liam: Added region blurb and perf numbers: marketplace deploys target <150ms TTF; on-prem kits target <320ms TTF. Included median-of-3 runs note.

ben: Proctor checklist snippet I added:
- verify kit boots to image v1.2
- run `redwood smoke --quick`
- capture logs and TTF, upload to shared drive
- confirm model artifact checksum

kevin: Suggest we include a fallback step for model download failures (signed URL refresh + retry).

hana: Good. Marketing blackout: propose embargo from ship date until partner signoff after training (max 10 days). Legal ok? Cristina, confirm.

cristina: I'll double-check with legal. If partners request earlier PR we need explicit waiver.

hana: Action items recap: Liam = marketplace + perf notes; Cristina = kit SOP + NDA followup; Ben = finalize cert + proctor checklist; Kevin = SME review + doc flag fixes. I'll stitch into a single handoff doc and ping for approvals.

ops-bot: Calendar: "SI Onboard Handoff" Fri 09:30 PT (invites sent).

hana: Thanks team. Post any blockers here so we keep this thread as the single source of truth. :white_check_mark:
